description: This file defines the custom exception class 'MissingRequiredPropertyException' used within the OpenMRS API project. The exception is thrown when an object property is missing that is required, providing multiple constructors for different use cases.

classes.name: MissingRequiredPropertyException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending APIException, indicating a missing required property in an object.

methods.name: MissingRequiredPropertyException(String message)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a specific error message.

methods.name: MissingRequiredPropertyException(String message, Throwable cause)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message and a cause.

methods.name: MissingRequiredPropertyException(String messageKey, Object[] parameters)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message key and parameters for localization.

methods.name: MissingRequiredPropertyException(Class clazz, String property)
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception indicating that a specific property of a class is required but missing.
